origin.description: Returns the current date and time.
origin.details: The instant changes with the clock. Leap seconds are ignored. The value is seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
origin.example:
x <- stri_datetime_now()
cat(paste0("stri_datetime_now() returns one finite instant: ", if (is.finite(unclass(x))) "TRUE" else "FALSE", ".\n"))

translation.details: The value is ICU's current time in seconds since the Unix epoch, the same unit as a POSIXct. Leap seconds are ignored. Compare a fixed instant when checking two processes.
translation.example:
import math
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_now
x = stri_datetime_now()
word = "TRUE" if math.isfinite(x) else "FALSE"
print(f"stri_datetime_now() returns one finite instant: {word}.")
